review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an opinion that news media caused many problems on people's lives today and this is a negative development. From my perspective, I agree that news media bring many impacts to people's lives but this is a both negative and positive development.

I strongly believe that news media have a lots influence on our lives. Firstly, the innovation of smartphones and the development of Internet allow people to follow the news instantly whenever and wherever they are, making news become a regular part of their routine. Secondly, the intense competition among news outlets in order to gain attention also lead to many effect for people. Most media agencies focus on shocking and breaking content and present it in a highly sensationalized manner with dramatic headlines and eye-catching visuals, which reinforces the overall impact of news on public opinion.

Admittedly, news media is a negative trend since it can makes people feel overly anxious and helpless because of the exposure to a constant stream of distressing and exaggerated news even in situations that do not directly affect them. However, we shouldn't deny the benefit of news on people's lives. The coverage of news can warn the public to existing and looming problems in society, say, crime, natural disasters or political corruption. This helps individuals has better informed and more prepared each to respond to potential threat or even handle risks in an increasingly complex society.
In conclusion, Despite the influence of news media, I believe that this development brings both positive and negative.

completion.comment: Em đã hoàn thành đủ bốn phần trên trang nguồn đã xác minh.

review.overall: Em đã có đủ bốn nhánh nội dung và nối được tin tức giật gân với ảnh hưởng lên dư luận. Tuy nhiên, câu đầu đổi nghĩa đề thành gây vấn đề; câu chủ đề Body 2 chỉ gọi truyền thông là tiêu cực dù đoạn có cả lợi. Các lỗi a lots, can makes, helps individuals has và kết bài thiếu danh từ cho thấy em cần tự soát cấu trúc câu kỹ hơn. Cô giữ chuỗi ý và cách giải thích riêng của em, sửa đúng những điểm làm nghĩa hoặc câu chưa hoàn chỉnh.
